A1.justification: Both 30-page PDFs describe the same MOCK study and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Pages 2–28 match exactly in extracted text and rendered appearance; changes are localized to the author block and final appendix pages.

before.justification: Sections 4–5 report original experiments on synthetic and real datasets, including the prediction results in Table 2 and pendulum and buoy experiments. Appendix G also reports measured training runtimes.

after.justification: v4 retains those original experimental results and adds a slope-regression ablation on the noisy FitzHugh–Nagumo dataset in Appendix H.

M1.justification: MOCK's integral objective, Algorithms 1–2, kernel constructions, and inference procedure are unchanged. Appendix H introduces an alternative loss for an ablation comparator, without revising the proposed MOCK method.

E1.justification: The nine benchmark datasets and the additional pendulum and buoy datasets are retained. Appendix H reuses the existing noisy FitzHugh–Nagumo dataset and trajectory-prediction task, adding no dataset, domain, or noise condition.

E2.justification: Appendix H adds an evaluated regularized slope-regression comparator using finite-difference derivative estimates and a Gaussian kernel. The comparator membership in the existing benchmark comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix H adds a controlled experimental setup using finite-difference slope targets from two-point trajectories, retaining the Gaussian RKHS, regularization form, MOCK validation procedure, and existing Err metric. Previously reported experimental settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The new Appendix H tests whether replacing integral fitting with slope regression worsens prediction on noisy data. This adds one focused NFHN/Gaussian-kernel ablation; the existing kernel comparisons and supplementary analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 4.5's Wilcoxon tests, Fisher combination, and significance reporting remain unchanged. Appendix H provides an error value without adding run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or a statistical test.

E6.justification: Appendix H newly reports an NFHN Err of 1.9 for slope regression, compared with the Gaussian MOCK error of 1.40 already present in Table 2 in both versions. Existing benchmark scores, constrained-kernel results, and runtime values are unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix H adds the mathematical definition of the derivative-regression objective in equation (91) and its finite-difference specialization in equation (92). The existing vvRKHS definitions, Theorem 1, proofs, and complexity derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about linear dimensional scaling, multivariate and constrained vector-field learning, and benchmark performance. The appendix ablation supplies additional support without redefining those core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix H adds an interpretation linking the regression comparator's higher error to the difficulty of estimating derivatives from noisy observations, arguing that integral estimation is preferable. Existing interpretations and stated limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix H documents the regression target formula, its evaluation at each two-point trajectory's initial observation, the Gaussian kernel, and reuse of MOCK's validation procedure. Existing software, hardware, and code/data access disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to earlier occupation-kernel and competing methods are unchanged. Appendix H introduces no additional citations or revised novelty claims.

P1.justification: v4 appends a short Regression Ablation Study section, adds Nicholas Fisher to the authors, and reorders Michael Wells. The existing prose and section organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The expanded author block and added appendix equations and prose cause localized layout changes. Figure 7 moves upward within page 30, interrupting the continuation of Appendix H; its contents and the other figures and tables are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Appendix H adds a previously missing direct comparison with slope regression in the same RKHS, reporting NFHN error 1.9 against Gaussian MOCK's retained 1.40. Its explicit objective and matched validation provide useful, limited support for the integral formulation. Coverage of only one dataset and kernel, without uncertainty reporting, limits the strength of this improvement.
